answer_1.quote: This paper introduces TAPERA, aiming to enhance the trustworthiness of LLM-based methods in long-form TAble QA.

answer_2.quote: Following QTSUMM, we adopt following popular automated evaluation metrics: • BLEU ... • ROUGE ... • METEOR ... • BERTScore ... • TAPAS-Acc ... • AutoACU

answer_4.quote: Eight human evaluators were engaged to assess 250 predictions from each listed system.
answer_4.guideline: We assess the following two dimensions: • Faithfulness: A good answer should correctly answer the given question. It should not contain any unfaithful or hallucinated text. • Comprehensiveness: A good answer should provide all the necessary information to answer the question.
